name: Resolution Proposal
definition: Conditions that must be met to propose a resolution.

ResolutionProposalThreshold.name: Resolution Proposal Threshold
ResolutionProposalThreshold.definition: Specifies the minimum stake in share capital or cash value or number of security holders required to table resolutions.

ResolutionProposalThresholdPercentage.name: Resolution Proposal Threshold Percentage
ResolutionProposalThresholdPercentage.definition: Specifies the minimum stake in share capital or cash value or number of security holders required to table resolutions. This minimum is expressed as a percentage.

Meeting.name: Meeting
Meeting.definition: Meeting for which conditions for proposing a resolution are specified.
